symptom: `describe nanoflow` prints no `grant execute on nanoflow … to <roles>;` for a nanoflow with allowed module roles, while `describe microflow` prints its grant; a describe -> exec round trip (or a copy under a new name) loses the nanoflow's access rules. `diff-local` on the same nanoflow did show the grant
cause: `describeNanoflow` is its own copy of the flow header/footer renderer and never had the grant block that `describeMicroflow` and `renderMicroflowMDL` each carried inline; the backend did populate `Nanoflow.AllowedModuleRoles` (see the mdl/backend finding of 2026-06-30)
insight: Three renderers for one flow footer: two had the grant, one did not. Moved the grant into `grantExecuteLines(flowType, name, roles)` used by all three. Mock test parses the describe output with `visitor.Build` and asserts a `GrantNanoflowAccessStmt` with the roles, so the line is proven to read back, not just to be printed
